title: Design System: Daredevil, a fan tribute

display.purpose: Footer name only, uppercase, condensed (wdth 62), edge to edge.

braille-letter.purpose: Letters resolving above the hero braille cells; rest at 7% opacity, lit by the echo.

headline.purpose: Section headings, sentence case, balanced wrap.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Echo light snap-up, press feedback, entrances, arrow nudge.

motion.name: echo-speed
motion.purpose: Ring expansion; an element lights when the ring reaches its nearest edge (delay = distance / speed).

motion.name: echo-glow
motion.value: opacity rest -> peak by 7%, hold to 32%, ease-in-out back to rest; 2800ms full echo, 1500ms hover ping
motion.purpose: Per-element WAAPI glow on opacity, interruptible from the on-screen value.

motion.name: echo-rings
motion.value: red lead ring at 0ms (peak 0.9), ink ring at 110ms (0.45 full / 0.3 ping); about 8 live at most

motion.name: hover-ping-limit
motion.value: 600ms and 260px of travel between pings; ping radius 260px
motion.purpose: Mouse-only small pings that never flood the page.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Press feedback on buttons, toggle and roster.

motion.name: entrance
motion.purpose: Transform-only section entrance; content never hidden by opacity.

motion.name: rest-opacity
motion.purpose: Resting state of echo-lit content; above 4.5:1 for reading text.

motion.name: fully-lit-fallback
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, no script, or Lights up (.all-lit)
motion.purpose: No rings or entrances; everything at full opacity.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single filled call to action: square, Signal Red Fill, trailing arrow.
components.html: Walk Hell's Kitchen
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: var(--red-fill, #b5121b); color: #fff; text-decoration: none; font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; padding: 18px 28px; border-radius: 0; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-button svg { transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-button:hover { background: #c8141e; } .ds-button:hover svg { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-button:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--red, #e0303a); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Lights Toggle
components.description: Square pressed-state toggle that renders the page fully lit.
components.css: .ds-toggle { font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink, #eeeae3); background: var(--ground-2, #131315); border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-toggle:hover { background: #1d1d20; } .ds-toggle:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-toggle[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--ink, #eeeae3); color: var(--ground, #0b0b0c); } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--red, #e0303a); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Plain text row: wordmark, dimmed section links, red-underlined destination link.
components.html: Daredevil, a fan tributeWho he isEssential runsHell's Kitchen
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 12px 32px; padding: 28px 32px; background: var(--ground, #0b0b0c); color: var(--ink, #eeeae3); font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; opacity: 0.7; transition: opacity 160ms ease; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-nav a:hover { opacity: 1; } .ds-nav .ds-wordmark { opacity: 1; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.0625rem; margin-right: auto; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-action { opacity: 1; font-weight: 600; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--red, #e0303a); padding-bottom: 4px; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--red, #e0303a); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Roster
components.description: Large borderless name buttons; the selected name gets a 12px red point.
components.css: .ds-roster { display: grid; background: var(--ground, #0b0b0c); padding: 16px; } .ds-roster button { font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #eeeae3); background: none; border: 0; padding: 10px 0; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; font-size: 2.25rem; font-weight: 750; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 80; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-roster button::before { content: ''; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--red, #e0303a); opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.5); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), opacity 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); flex: none; } .ds-roster button[aria-pressed='true']::before, .ds-roster button:hover::before { opacity: 1; transform: none; } .ds-roster button:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-roster button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--red, #e0303a); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Readout Panel
components.description: Square Raised Ground panel with a red ECG line over name, meta and description.
components.html:
Foggy Nelson

Ally, resting at 96 bpm

His law partner and best friend since law school.
components.css: .ds-readout { background: var(--ground-2, #131315); color: var(--ink, #eeeae3); padding: 32px; display: grid; gap: 28px; border-radius: 0; font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-readout svg { width: 100%; height: 140px; color: var(--red, #e0303a); overflow: visible; } .ds-readout path { fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linejoin: round; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; } .ds-readout-text { display: grid; gap: 8px; } .ds-readout h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 2.25rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.05; } .ds-readout p { margin: 0; } .ds-meta { font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Echo Photograph
components.description: Greyscale photograph at rest; its colour copy fades in when echoed (hover/focus stands in for the echo here). Placeholder fill stands in for a real photo.
components.css: .ds-photo { margin: 0; display: grid; gap: 14px; width: 320px; color: var(--ink, #eeeae3); font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-frame { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; overflow: hidden; background: var(--ground-2, #131315); border-radius: 0; } .ds-img { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: #3b4252; } .ds-color { background: #7a2a2f; } .ds-mono { filter: grayscale(1) brightness(0.62); } .ds-color { opacity: 0; transition: opacity 700ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-photo:hover .ds-color, .ds-photo:focus-visible .ds-color { opacity: 1; } .ds-photo:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--red, #e0303a); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-photo figcaption { font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Braille Cell
components.description: A braille cell with a condensed letter resting at 7%; hover lights the letter and shrinks the raised dots, as the echo does.
components.html: D
components.css: .ds-cell { position: relative; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 120px; height: 180px; background: var(--ground, #0b0b0c); } .ds-dots { position: absolute; width: 64px; aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr); grid-auto-flow: column; place-items: center; } .ds-dots i { width: 74%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink, #eeeae3); opacity: 0.16; transform: scale(0.3); transition: opacity 400ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), transform 400ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-dots i.on { opacity: 0.72; transform: none; } .ds-letter { font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 170px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 750; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 62; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--ink, #eeeae3); opacity: 0.07; transition: opacity 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-cell:hover .ds-letter { opacity: 1; } .ds-cell:hover .ds-dots i.on { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.4); }

components.name: Echo Ring
components.description: Thin expanding rings: red lead, ink follower 110ms later, linear expansion fading out.
components.css: .ds-echo { position: relative; width: 320px; height: 200px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--ground, #0b0b0c); } .ds-ring { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 360px; height: 360px; margin: -180px 0 0 -180px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #eeeae3); opacity: 0; animation: ds-ring 1600ms linear 110ms infinite; } .ds-lead { border: 2px solid var(--red, #e0303a); animation-delay: 0ms; } @keyframes ds-ring { from { transform: scale(0.01); opacity: 0.9; } to { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-ring { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The page is a dark room that answers sound. Everything rests dim on a near-black ground; a tap or pointer press sends a ring outward at a constant speed, and each element brightens the instant the ring reaches its nearest edge, then settles back. Photographs rest grey and regain colour only when echoed. The world is built from very few materials: one warm off-white ink, one red, one variable typeface, thin rings, and real street photography of Hell's Kitchen.

Density is editorial and generous: big tight-set headlines, a twelve-column grid with wide section breaks, and long passages of plain reading text that never need the echo to be legible. Restraint is the brand: one signature effect, small supporting moments (a heartbeat line, an ECG readout, a red point that marks the selected name). The comic-splash hero, costume imagery and red gradients are refused.

Accessibility is part of the world, not an exception to it. Resting text stays above 4.5:1; the braille headline carries real text for assistive tech; reduced motion, no script, and the "Lights up" toggle all render the page fully lit and static.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground, warm ink, one red used sparingly for signal.
Content rests dim (62% opacity) and is lit by expanding echo rings.
Archivo variable only; condensed width (wdth 62) for the braille letters, run years and footer name.
Square rectangles everywhere; the only circles are braille dots, echo rings and the selection point.
Flat surfaces; depth comes from light (opacity and colour), never shadow.
Photographs desaturated at rest, colour when echoed.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red is a signal: rings, lines, a point, one button. It never fills a section, a gradient or a background.

rules.name: The Resting Light Rule
rules.body: Echo-lit content rests at 62% opacity (`--rest: 0.62`), which keeps warm ink on ground above 4.5:1. Anything that must be read rests no dimmer than this. The single exception is the braille letter (`--rest-letter: 0.07`), which can rest near-invisible because its braille dots and the visually hidden heading carry the word at rest.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Condensed width (wdth 62) belongs to the braille-resolved letters, years and the footer name. Running text stays at wdth 100. Do not introduce a second family.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings and labels are sentence case; the only uppercase is the footer name.

rules.name: The Light Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy and focus are carried by opacity and colour. No box-shadow, no glow, no blur.

rules.name: The Mask-Only Gradient Rule
rules.body: A radial gradient appears only as an alpha mask defining where the echo's light falls on the hero photograph; never as a visible colour fill.

dos: Do rest echo-lit reading content at 62% opacity and light it to full only through the echo.
Do keep red to lines, points and the single primary button.
Do use Archivo's width axis (wdth 62) for big letterforms and numerals, and wdth 100 for reading.
Do keep every rectangle square and reserve circles for dots, rings and the selection point.
Do rest photographs in greyscale and return their colour on echo.
Do make every motion interruptible from its on-screen value and provide a fully lit static state for reduced motion.
Do gate hover effects behind fine-pointer hover media queries and give presses a small scale-down (0.96–0.98).
donts: Don't add shadows, glows, blur or visible gradients; depth is light.
Don't fill large areas or backgrounds with red.
Don't hide content behind opacity that only script can lift; entrances use transform only.
Don't let reading text rest dimmer than 62%; the near-invisible resting state is for the braille letters alone.
Don't introduce a second typeface or round the corners of buttons and panels.
Don't use Marvel art, logos, costume imagery or comic-splash composition.
